stem_book: Which is correct about ΔG? (a) ΔG = ΔH − TΔS (b) At equilibrium, ΔG° = 0 (c) ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q (Q = reaction quotient) (d) Both (a) and (c)
reason: Print has (c) ΔG = ΔG° + RT log K, which is true only at equilibrium; the intended reaction-isotherm uses Q and ln, corrected so the key (d) holds.
work: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS (a ✓); ΔG = ΔG° + RT ln Q (c ✓); at equilibrium ΔG = 0, not ΔG° (b ✗) → (d)
